name: Paneer Keema
steps: Crumble paneer by hand into small uneven pieces, but do not grind it into a paste. Blanch peas for 3 minutes and drain.
Heat oil and cumin in a wide pan. Add onions and fry 7–8 minutes until golden; add ginger-garlic paste and green chili for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, coriander powder, chili powder and 5 g salt. Cook uncovered 8–10 minutes, pressing the tomatoes until thick and almost dry.
Add peas and crumbled paneer. Toss gently over medium heat for 4–5 minutes until the paneer is coated and heated but still soft.
Sprinkle garam masala, remaining salt and coriander leaves. Serve the moist, mince-like keema with pav or roti.
tips: Add crumbled paneer at the end; prolonged frying dries it out.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
